products.name: Elai.io
products.note: AI avatar video; text-to-video; multilingual; enterprise training; consent

profile_text.body:
Elai is an AI video generation platform, now operating under the banner of Panopto, that focuses on producing training and presentation videos through automated tools. The company describes its product, Elai.io, as one of the most powerful AI training video generators on the market, and positions it as an advanced and intuitive solution for enterprise and educational use cases.

Elai.io allows users to create videos by converting text to speech and pairing it with AI-generated avatars chosen from a preset cast of video presenters, or built from a user's own likeness. The platform supports multilingual output and is aimed at organizations producing training content at scale. The site emphasizes ease of use and a quality user experience as core differentiators.

The held facts confirm Elai.io is catalogued under the Video Generation and Editing category, with noted capabilities spanning text-to-video, multilingual support, enterprise training, and avatar consent handling. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
